prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1332; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a Katy, Texas roadway when Driver 2 attempted to change lanes and made contact with the side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 is the named insured on the policy involved. Responding officers spoke with both drivers and with two independent witnesses, all of whom gave accounts consistent with the sideswipe as described. Photographs taken at the scene show damage along the right side of Driver 1's vehicle that lines up with the reported point of impact. A Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time and was identified and confirmed present by officers and witnesses. Driver 1 reported a knee injury and stated it occurred during the collision. Officers noted a few older scratches on the vehicle's body that may predate this incident, and the report does not establish whether any injury was caused by this crash. Further medical information will be needed to make that determination.
